summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Plan Gráfico enhancements and AthleteSummary 2-column layout. All new features verified: chart type selectors work correctly, Eventos/Competencias row is present, and AthleteSummary component displays athlete data in 2-column layout. Found and fixed 1 bug: API_URL was undefined in GraphicPlan.js.

Plan Gráfico: Chart type selector for Carga chart opens and shows 3 options (Barras, Líneas, Áreas)
Plan Gráfico: Selecting 'Líneas superpuestas' changes chart type to line chart
Plan Gráfico: 'Volumen e Intensidad por Semanas' chart renders with Combination (Bars + Line) type
Plan Gráfico: Second chart has its own type selector dropdown
Plan Gráfico: 'Eventos / Competencias' row visible in periodization table with 'Calendario' sub-row
Atletas: 2-column layout working - athlete list on left, AthleteSummary on right
AthleteSummary: Placeholder shown when no athlete selected ('Selecciona un atleta')
AthleteSummary: When athlete selected, shows athlete name, sport, level, age
AthleteSummary: Displays 'Datos Antropométricos' section with 'Ver más' link
AthleteSummary: Displays 'Test y Evaluaciones' section with 'Ver más' link
AthleteSummary: Shows 'Acciones rápidas' with 'Plan de Entrenamiento' and 'Plan Gráfico' buttons
AthleteSummary: Quick action buttons navigate correctly
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: GraphicPlan.js line 322 used undefined 'API_URL' instead of 'BACKEND_URL' - this would cause events loading to fail
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test athlete 'UI Test Athlete' via API for testing AthleteSummary component
